How a transformer tracks beliefs in a bracketed Mess3 process: pilot results

One network: 4 layers, d = 128, 4 heads, context 128, trained 8,000 steps at batch 64 (about 12 minutes). One seed. Its loss is 2.5 mnat/token above exact Bayes. All readouts are linear, fitted on 576 sequences and shown on the other 192.

The process, as a PCFG

Tokens: content A B C, one open bracket #, three close brackets ) ] }. A bracket has a hidden type k (one of three) and a hidden Mess3 state s. Rk,s is the root, which never closes; Xk,s is an open bracket.

S → Rk,s1/9type and state chosen uniformly
Rk,s → x Rk,s′(1 − po) · Tkx[s,s′]emit a content token; Mess3 of type k moves s → s′
Rk,s → # Xj,u Rk,spo / 9open a child of type j in state u; then resume in the same state
Xk,s → x Xk,s′(1 − po − pc) · Tkx[s,s′]
Xk,s → # Xj,u Xk,spo / 9
Xk,s → ckpcclose with the token of the bracket's own type: c1 = ), c2 = ], c3 = }

x ∈ {A, B, C}. Tkx[s,s′] is the probability that the Mess3 of type k goes from state s to s′ and emits x. Mess3 parameters (x, a): type ) (0.05, 0.85), sticky; type ] (0.15, 0.6), noisy; type } (0.45, 0.85), anti-persistent. po = 0.1, pc = 0.12; no bracket opens at depth 8; sequences are the first 128 tokens.

The open token is the same for every type and only the close names it, so inside a bracket the type has to be inferred from the content. Every push and pop is visible in the token itself (a visibly pushdown language), and a bracket's content is independent of everything outside it.

Example: ABAC#ABBBC)CABCBACA##BBBBCBBB)}BBBCBBC#BCC#]B]CAC#)BCBA#BBCCAACB

Question 0. After block 3 the three beliefs sit in nearly separate planes (overlap 0.12–0.16); after block 4 they have partly merged (0.49–0.92). A type's belief is read as well where that type is unlikely (R² 0.94) as where it is likely (0.95). Caveats: the readouts are blurred versions of the exact fractals; and in this Mess3 family two of the three beliefs are almost linear functions of the others (R² 0.97), so the plane estimates are weakly identified.
Question 1. At a # both readouts fall to the prior (1/3), from the root and from inside a bracket alike. At a close the network's own predictions put 0.62 on the parent's favoured type (exact 0.66); the linear readout recovers less (0.55), so the type posterior is not fully linear in the residual there. Changing tokens outside the current bracket moves the prediction by 0.1 mnat at most, against about 140 where the prediction should change.
Question 2. Depth is linearly readable after block 1 (R² 0.95); the distance back to the bracket's own # and the count of its tokens by block 3 (0.84, 0.86). Just after a close, block 4 head 1 puts 0.90 of its attention on the bracket's own tokens, which lie behind the closed child. This shows the tags are present and that attention follows the bracket; that the heads read the tag itself has not been tested causally.
